recognize_zh: 胸水中一大團黏著的上皮樣細胞（核圓偏位、胞質空泡化），邊緣與團內可見三顆胞質佈滿紫紅色異染性顆粒的肥大細胞。
features: Large cohesive cluster of epithelioid cells with round eccentric nuclei and abundant vacuolated blue cytoplasm
Mast cell at lower left and another at right edge with cytoplasm packed with purple-red metachromatic granules
Additional mast cell with dense granules within the cluster
Dark crushed nuclear material and small lymphocytes within and around the cluster
No significant nuclear pleomorphism evident at this magnification
describe_en: Pleural fluid cytocentrifuge preparation shows a large cohesive cluster of epithelioid cells with round eccentric nuclei and abundant vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm. Mast cells with cytoplasm filled with purple-red metachromatic granules are present at the edges and within the cluster, and small lymphocytes and crushed nuclei are interspersed. Marked nuclear pleomorphism is not evident in this field. Findings demonstrate mast cells in pleural fluid; the epithelioid cluster requires immunocytochemistry to distinguish reactive mesothelial cells from metastatic carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Basophils are smaller with segmented nuclei and fewer, coarser granules.

ddx.dx: Reactive mesothelial cells vs metastatic carcinoma
ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells are calretinin/WT1-positive with intercellular windows, whereas carcinoma is claudin-4/MOC-31/BerEP4-positive.
Siderophages contain refractile golden-brown or blue-black pigment that is Prussian blue positive.
